name: Bunanas
summary:
Bunanas is a Gorilla Tag fangame, with a different style apart from the original game to fit Bunanas creator’s personality.

This is the new version of the game, If you have the old game, It should say “OLD” at the end of the name.

And as the monkes in the real world say:
Ooh-ooh-haa-haa!

Reject Humanity, Become Monke.
